title: Oxygen player launch file
description: Everything Oxygen.Player needs to run one cooked scene. Relative paths are relative to the folder of the launch file.

mounts.description: Cooked content, highest precedence last: a file ending in .pak is a PAK file, anything else a loose cooked root.

scene.description: Virtual path of the scene to play, e.g. /.cooked/Scenes/Level.oscene.

script_source_roots.description: Roots of external script sources. Non-empty enables reloading a script when its source changes.

frame_cap.description: Frame rate limit in frames per second; 0 is off.

diagnostics_pipe.description: Name of a named pipe the launcher listens on (without the \\.\pipe\ prefix). The player connects to it and streams events.
